description: This file defines a test implementation of the IQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor interface, along with a serializable counters class for tracking method call counts in unit tests.

classes.name: EventHubReceiverMonitorForTesting
classes.description: A test monitor class implementing IQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor to track call counts for initialization, read, message reception, and shutdown events.

classes.name: EventHubReceiverMonitorCounters
classes.description: A serializable class containing counters for each monitored method, used to facilitate counting and testing.

methods.name: TrackInitialization
methods.description: Increments the initialization call counter if the operation was successful.

methods.name: TrackRead
methods.description: Increments the read call counter if the read was successful.

methods.name: TrackMessagesReceived
methods.description: Increments the message received counter; also accepts counts and timestamps but only increments the counter.

methods.name: TrackShutdown
methods.description: Increments the shutdown call counter if the shutdown was successful.
